title: Shared Microsoft 365 Host Architecture

selectionRules.discontiguousSelectionBehavior: getSelectedRange failure maps to host selection failure

excel.staleGuard: fresh selected cell must match the preview snapshot exactly before mutation
excel.replaceWrite: write exact SDK unicodeBraille as the new single-cell value
excel.insertAfterReasonDeferred: Appending by rewriting the cell can cause Excel formula coercion for text beginning with formula markers and would require host-specific escaping/format semantics. Phase 10 MVP does not invent those semantics.

powerpoint.staleGuard: fresh selected text range must match slide, shape, start, length, and text exactly before mutation
powerpoint.replaceWrite: set selected TextRange.text to exact SDK unicodeBraille
powerpoint.insertAfterReasonDeferred: PowerPoint does not expose Word.Range.insertText semantics on TextRange. Reconstructing selected text plus Braille would be a replacement with possible formatting consequences, so Phase 10 MVP does not label that as Insert After.

selectionService.previewRule: controller may inspect only common sourceText and SDK translation projection; host mutation context remains opaque to the shared UI
selectionService.mutationRule: host service owns stale-selection validation and all Office object-model writes

viewRules: ready state displays active host label
unsupported actions are disabled or hidden by capability, never simulated
host failure remains distinct from application and translation failure domains

manifestArchitecture.versionOverridesStrategy: one VersionOverridesV1_0 with three host command entries
manifestArchitecture.commandRule: one shared VersionOverrides Hosts collection with one command child structure per Office application
manifestArchitecture.applicationApiRequirementRule: application-specific API baselines are enforced at runtime with Office.context.requirements.isSetSupported

phase10_5SchemaCorrection.reason: The official Microsoft manifest validator rejected multiple sibling task-pane VersionOverridesV1_0 elements under OfficeApp.
phase10_5SchemaCorrection.validatorError: OfficeApp has invalid child VersionOverrides after the first VersionOverrides; schema expects ExtendedOverrides or XML signature.
phase10_5SchemaCorrection.resolution: Use one task-pane VersionOverridesV1_0 containing Document, Workbook, and Presentation command hosts; keep only AddinCommands 1.1 in manifest requirements and enforce WordApi/ExcelApi/PowerPointApi baselines at runtime.

implementationOrder: 10.3 refactor shared task-pane layer and implement Excel adapter
10.5 materialize and validate the three-host manifest and collect live-host evidence
nonGoals: multi-cell Excel translation in Phase 10 MVP
Excel formula translation or formula rewriting
Excel Insert After in Phase 10 MVP
PowerPoint Insert After in Phase 10 MVP
direct Core calls from Office integration
claiming live Excel or PowerPoint verification before it occurs
